title: Documentation
description: The software and the interfaces: the T3000 application, the web UI that is replacing its screens, the APIs and message sets behind both, the register maps and the firmware.

title: Products
description: The hardware: the controllers and thermostats you put on a wall, the boards that add points to them, and the sensors and meters that report to them.

title: Tools
description: Pages you work with rather than read: the psychrometric chart, the pH chart, and the browser simulator for the TSTAT10.

title: Topics
description: Subjects that cross products: semantic tagging, networking, protocols, security, alarms.

title: Training & Labs
description: Ordered reading for a job, labs you can work through on a real controller, and the commissioning checks that prove them.

title: Internal
description: Runbooks and tooling for the people who build and ship the products. Not published.

title: Q&A
description: Questions from installers and engineers, answered by the people who build the products.
